verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a POS/commerce platform, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export of all data in open formats (e.g., CSV/JSON) or an offboarding path. The QuickBooks item covers migrating into Shopify POS, not out of it, and GraphQL Admin API access from extensions is a developer building block, not an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
